source_checks.finding: Page confirmed. Exact words: 'Select Start > Settings > System > Storage > Cleanup recommendations.' Categories: 'Temporary files', 'Large or unused files', 'Files synced to the cloud', 'Unused apps.' 'After you've selected items to remove, select the Clean up button for each section.' 'If it's been fewer than 10 days since you upgraded Windows' lists the previous version as a deletable system file; deleting it removes the 'Windows.old folder, which contains files that give you the option to go back to your previous version of Windows.' 'If you delete your previous version of Windows, this can't be undone.' Applies To: Windows 11 and Windows 10, so the ref's Windows 11 applicability is accurate.

required_actions.action: Open Start > Settings > System > Storage > Cleanup recommendations
Choose the items to remove in the four categories
Click the Clean up button in each section
Warning: deleting the previous Windows version removes Windows.old and cannot be undone; the option appears only if the upgrade was within 10 days
